tailoring.note: Tailoring and First Aid are both complete. All 2,334 Tailoring comparison requests resolved; usable relative-rank evidence covered 377 of 389 finished outputs, 384 bands changed, 139 large changes were accepted, and five insufficiently supported large changes retained their frozen bands. Seventeen Phase 1B cloth intermediates remain unchanged. All 17 First Aid outputs are Evidence-priced; all 102 comparison requests resolved with three-realm coverage for every item and no completed-sale history.

skinning-leatherworking.note: All 490 crafts are covered: 476 finished-output Evidence Pricing decisions and 14 preserved Phase 1B leather and cured-hide intermediate decisions. All 2,856 comparison requests resolved; one sparse Tough Scorpid Shoulders sale received 25% weight.

fishing-cooking.note: All 162 auctionable Cooking outputs are Evidence-priced. All 972 comparison requests resolved; 159 outputs had three-realm coverage and three had two-realm coverage. Exact recipe and minimum guaranteed batch-yield costs remain separate craftability diagnostics.

turn-ins.note: The 26 grouped rows were replaced by 74 exact tradeable item rows. All 444 comparison requests resolved with three-realm coverage for every item; 70 bands changed and four shared crafting-material bands were preserved. Three BoP items and the obsolete grouped Timbermaw section were removed.

recipe-pattern-drops.note: All 90 recipe items were audited for profession, skill, binding, learned-output market, pinned loot paths, and vendor competition. All 540 comparison requests resolved; 89 items had three-realm coverage and one had two. Eighty-nine bands changed. Five limited-vendor recipes received deterministic vendor-cost corrections, and the user-set 25g Book of Glyph Mastery Target was preserved.

level-80-boe-epics.note: All 85 Level-80 BoEs were revalidated with today's local sales/supply snapshot and refreshed full three-realm comparison coverage. Seventy bands changed; 34 Targets rose, 34 fell, and 17 stayed unchanged. Surge Needle Ring was the only Target change over 50% and passed the explicit slot, stats/effects, buyer, source-cohort, and coverage review.

sought-after-world-drops.note: All 262 sought-after world drops were revalidated in separate leveling, bracket, level-70, iconic, container, world-boss, raid-trash, and special-source cohorts. Two hundred thirty-nine bands changed; 120 Targets rose, 97 fell, and 45 stayed unchanged. Eight Target changes over 50% passed the explicit item and coverage review.

collectibles.note: All 133 verified auctionable companions, mounts, accessories, and event novelties are covered. Unlimited vendors, limited-stock vendors, token vendors, drops, quests, crafts, rare rewards, and every individual season are separated. One sparse Wood Frog sale received 25% weight; active listings remained supply-only evidence and nominal external gold was not copied.
